meta.title: Pokémon Battle Simulator: PvP, vs Computer & Team Builder
meta.description: Free Pokémon battle simulator on Pokémon Showdown's engine: live PvP online, battle a friend or the computer, plus a team builder and damage calculator.

cpu.title: Battle vs Computer
cpu.blurb: Battle a computer that plays to win.
cpu.p1: Random Battle, Random Doubles or your saved team
cpu.p3: Showdown's move animations, Tera and all

online.title: Battle Online
online.blurb: Find an opponent, or invite a friend.
online.p1: Matchmaking in every format, random teams or your own
online.p2: Showdown's turn timer; each side sees only what it should

teams.title: Team Builder
teams.blurb: Build teams, checked as you go.
teams.p1: Formats from Gen 9 OU back to Gen 3 OU
teams.p2: EVs, IVs, natures and live stats

calc.title: Damage Calc
calc.p1: Boosts, status, Tera and current HP
calc.p3: Load sets straight from your teams

lab.title: Battle Lab
lab.blurb: Run any matchup thousands of times.
lab.p1: Any Pokémon, level, item and move, Gen 1 to 9
lab.p2: Smart, Greedy, Random or Scripted play per side
lab.p3: Win % with a 95% confidence interval, KOs, crits, replays

factory.title: Battle Factory
factory.blurb: Rent a team and build a streak.
factory.p1: Level 100 Factory or level 50 BSS Factory
factory.p2: Trade for your opponent's Pokémon after each win
factory.p3: Or battle live: both trainers rent a team

tower.title: Battle Tower
tower.blurb: Your team vs a streak of trainers.
tower.p2: Saved, built or quick teams, checked by Showdown
tower.p3: The Tower Tycoon every seventh battle

formatBlurb.gen9ou: Smogon's flagship singles tier: everything below Ubers.
formatBlurb.gen9ubers: Box legendaries welcome. Only the most broken are banned.
formatBlurb.gen9uu: The tier below OU: no OU or UUBL Pokémon.
formatBlurb.gen9ru: The tier below UU: no UU or RUBL Pokémon.
formatBlurb.gen9nu: The tier below RU: no RU or NUBL Pokémon.
formatBlurb.gen9pu: The tier below NU: no NU or PUBL Pokémon.
formatBlurb.gen9lc: Little Cup: first-stage Pokémon that can evolve, at level 5.
formatBlurb.gen9monotype: Every Pokémon on a team shares a type. No Terastallizing.
formatBlurb.gen9doublesou: Two on two, Smogon's doubles tier list.
formatBlurb.gen9vgc2025regi: Official doubles: bring six, pick four, level 50, two restricted legendaries.
formatBlurb.gen9nationaldex: Scarlet / Violet mechanics with every Pokémon, Mega Stone and Z-Crystal back.

formatBlurb.gen3ou: Ruby / Sapphire / Emerald: a move's type decides physical or special.

info.name: Pokémon battles
info.description: A free Pokémon battle simulator on Pokémon Showdown's engine: battle the computer, a friend or a stranger, with a team builder, damage calculator and Battle Lab.
info.intro: This Pokémon battle simulator runs on Pokémon Showdown's own engine: battle the computer, a friend through a link, or an opponent found online.
info.step1: Pick a mode: battle the computer, battle online, or open the Battle Frontier.
info.step2: Use a random team or build your own in the team builder.
info.step3: Choose your moves each turn and win the battle.
info.step4: Check matchups with the damage calculator or simulate thousands of battles in the Battle Lab.
info.labA: It lets you set up any matchup and have the engine play it thousands of times to estimate win odds.

meta.title: Pokémon Battle — vs Computer, Online or a Friend
meta.description: Real Pokémon battles on Pokémon Showdown's engine: Random Battle, Random Doubles or your own OU team, against a computer opponent, a trainer found by matchmaking, or a friend through an invite link.

play.title: Start a
play.intro: Pokémon Showdown's own battle engine: every move, ability and item works as it does there. Pick an opponent, a format and go.

meta.title: Battle Tower — Flat Rules Streaks vs the Computer

tower.description: The Battle Tower on Pokémon Showdown's engine: bring your team under Flat Rules (level 50, bring six, pick three) and build a streak against computer trainers, with the Tower Tycoon every seventh battle.
tower.name: Battle Tower
tower.title: Battle
tower.intro: Your team, Flat Rules, and a streak of computer trainers that get tougher as you climb. Every seventh battle is the Tower Tycoon, with its best team.

meta.title: Battle Factory — Rent a Team, Build a Streak

factory.description: The Battle Factory on Pokémon Showdown's engine: rent six Pokémon from Showdown's Battle Factory sets, win seven in a row against a computer that gets stronger, and trade for your opponent's Pokémon after every win.
factory.name: Battle Factory
factory.title: Battle
factory.intro: No team needed: rent six Pokémon from Pokémon Showdown's Battle Factory sets, win seven in a row, and trade one of yours for one of your opponent's after every win. Or find an opponent who rents one too, from the battle setup.
